title: Opinion: Opinion | Indus Treaty, Hague, And Pakistan's Endless Search For Leverage Over India
summary_full: If the IWT survived all the trials in the past, it is because India's threshold of tolerance had been unusually high. But Pakistan must know that it can't arm-twist India through international pressure.
